newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Dlr/yen vols up as spot yen demand swells.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Dlr/yen vols up as spot yen demand swells.

text.p: Implied volatilities on dollar/yen options rose throughout morning Europe amid healthy demand for spot yen, options traders said.
Dealers quoted one-month dollar/yen vol around 0.4 percent higher than previous closing European levels, and reported strong interest to buy yen calls out to three months.
"Yen vols are bid, against both the dollar and mark, both up 4/10 in one month. The risk reversals favour yen calls fairly strongly now," said an options trader at a U.S. bank in London.
One-month dollar/yen vol rose to 8.7 percent bid in morning Europe, though had eased to 8.4/8.9 by 0956 GMT, traders said.
It ended around 8.3 percent bid on Friday.
One-month risk reversals were skewed towards yen calls at 0.3/0.6 percent, traders said.
Dollar/mark vol was sidelined, trading unchanged at 8.2/8.6 percent in the one month. Risk reversals were narrowly bid for mark puts at 0.0/0.3 percent, traders said.
